description: This file defines a Prometheus metrics provider class for a server application, including metric initialization, endpoint setup, and metric incrementing, utilizing express and prom-client libraries.

classes.name: Prometheus
classes.description: A class implementing IMetricsProvider to manage Prometheus metrics, including initialization, endpoint setup, and metric updates.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metrics provider, 'Prometheus'.

methods.name: initializeCounters
methods.description: Initializes various counters, gauges, and histograms for metrics, and sets up the metrics endpoint.

methods.name: setupMetricsEndpoint
methods.description: Configures express routes and middleware to expose metrics and record request durations.

methods.name: incrementCounter
methods.description: Increments a specified counter metric with a given payload.

methods.name: registerMetrics
methods.description: Registers custom and default metrics with the registry, avoiding duplicates.
